technical.title: SpaceCache speeds up point-cloud segmentation by reusing intermediate features
technical.summary: SpaceCache is a training-free feature cache for point-cloud streams that reuses semantically consistent intermediate features from previous frames across transformer blocks, reducing redundant computations in autonomous driving.
technical.why: It optimizes inference efficiency for point-cloud processing pipelines essential to autonomous driving and robotics.

technical.title: Line-augmented cuVSLAM improves visual odometry in low-texture environments
technical.summary: A line-feature extension to CUDA-accelerated cuVSLAM utilizes Plüstracker coordinates and orthonormal representations to extract reliable straight-edge structures from featureless warehouses and aisles.
technical.why: It solves visual odometry failure modes in texture-poor industrial and warehousing environments for mobile robots.

technical.title: VLA-Δ framework supervises physical state transitions for better robot control
technical.summary: VLA-Δ is a general framework designed to prevent vision-language-action models from overfitting observation-action correspondences by explicitly supervising physical state changes between current and future states.
technical.why: It improves robot control accuracy by addressing the lack of intermediate physical state supervision in traditional VLA models.

technical.title: MJev-Spatial simplifies spatial understanding via native attention matching
technical.summary: MJev-Spatial treats candidate spatial locations as classes and scores them using native attention matching, providing a System 1 multimodal decision model for spatial tasks without relying on costly autoregressive text generation.
technical.why: It provides a faster, more unified approach to handling fundamental spatial intelligence tasks in vision-language models.

technical.title: DeSpatial addresses perception bottlenecks in 3D agentic spatial reasoning
technical.summary: DeSpatial explicitly decomposes spatial understanding to fix inconsistent predictions and fragmented object identities in spatial agents, addressing the core 3D perception bottleneck revealed through oracle experiments.
technical.why: It helps resolve critical perception inaccuracies that hinder reliable 3D scene interpretation for spatial agents.

technical.title: NVIDIA releases Nemotron 3.5 Super VL open multimodal agent model
technical.summary: NVIDIA released Nemotron 3.5 Super VL, an open 120B-parameter multimodal MoE model featuring 12B active parameters, a 1M-token context window, NVFP4 weights, and two accompanying edge models.
technical.why: It delivers a powerful open architecture for deploying large-scale multimodal agents.

technical.title: Block-sparse featurizers enable fine-grained steering in robot foundation models
technical.summary: Researchers investigate block-sparse featurizers to recover multi-dimensional, task-relevant features from robot foundation models, establishing an interpretable interface for internal behavior steering and data shaping.
technical.why: It offers better internal interpretability and control over the behavior of vision-language-action models.

technical.title: CoWorld Reasoner uses video world models for agentic multimodal reasoning
technical.summary: CoWorld Reasoner is an agentic framework that leverages a Video World Model as a unified visual reasoning engine to support flexible visual imagination across diverse spatiotemporal tasks.
technical.why: It offers an advanced approach for handling motion, actions, and view changes in multimodal reasoning.

models.title: Qwen-Image-2.1-Turbo Accelerates Generation with Eight Denoising Steps
models.summary: Qwen-Image-2.1-Turbo is an accelerated checkpoint for text-to-image generation and editing using only 8 denoising steps. It leverages prefix KV caching to reuse context across steps and includes its recommended sampling schedule out of the box.
models.why: It provides faster generation speeds for visual workflows using the Diffusers pipeline.

models.title: MiniCPM-V 4.7 Introduces First Open-Source MoE Vision Model with LES
models.summary: MiniCPM-V 4.7 is a 35B-A3B variant and the first mixture-of-experts model in the MiniCPM-V series. It enhances single-image, multi-image, and video understanding while introducing Lookahead Expert Scheduling for smooth on-device inference.
models.why: It advances efficient on-device video and multi-image understanding for edge computer vision tasks.

models.title: ConwayResearch Releases Underdog-Saluki-27B-1.0 Fitting in Under 8 GB
models.summary: Underdog-Saluki-27B-1.0 compresses Qwen3.8-27B to run in under 8 GB using GGUF for llama.cpp while keeping tool calling intact. It also offers a vision add-on compatible with the OpenAI chat API via `--mmproj`.
models.why: It enables lightweight local execution of a large vision-language model with tool-calling support.

models.title: Google DeepMind Releases EmbeddingGemma 2 Open Multimodal Embedding Model
models.summary: EmbeddingGemma 2 is an open multimodal embedding model that maps text, images, video, and audio into a unified 768-dimensional vector space. With 740M parameters, it runs on consumer hardware for low-latency on-device search and RAG.
models.why: It brings efficient, multimodal on-device embedding capabilities to developers working with edge hardware.

models.title: LiquidAI Releases LFM2.5-24B-A2B Reasoning Model for Fast On-Device Agents
models.summary: LFM2.5-24B-A2B is a 24B-parameter reasoning model with 2B active parameters designed for fast on-device agents. It incorporates a think-before-answer mechanism and runs up to 1.7x faster than comparable MoEs.
models.why: It delivers competitive agentic and tool-use performance suited for private edge deployment.

models.title: Qwen-Image-2.1 Uncensored Quantized Formats Released for ComfyUI
models.summary: This repository provides GGUF, Safetensors, and MLX quantized formats of Qwen-Image-2.1 for local image generation. It packages companion text encoders and VAE files directly for use with ComfyUI.
models.why: It enables flexible, localized execution of Qwen-Image models across various hardware platforms.
